newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fall 0.8 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fall 0.8 pct in November.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, declined 0.8 percent in November 1996 after a 4.6 percent increase in October, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Retail sales rose by 0.7 percent in November 1995.
Adjusted for inflation, real retail turnover was 1.2 percent lower, the office said.
For the first 11 months of 1996 the value of retail sales declined 1.1 percent on both a real and a price-adjusted basis.
